name: TJX CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: The TJX Companies, Inc. retails apparel and home fashion products through Marmaxx, HomeGoods, TJX Canada and TJX International segments. Marmaxx sells family apparel and home fashions, HomeGoods offers home furnishings and decor plus gourmet food, pet and kids departments, and TJX Canada runs the Winners, Marshalls and HomeSense chains.
